column1: # Which table belongs to which BIRD database, for the mini-dev PostgreSQL dump, which puts all 75 tables
# of the 11 databases into one schema ("public"). Used by scripts/load_bird.sh (layout C).
# Format: db_id <TAB> table. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# load_bird.sh checks this file against the tables that are really there before it splits anything,
# and stops with both differences listed if they disagree, so a wrong line cannot silently misfile a table.
